text: 金十数据8月3日讯，当被问及美联储是否会受制于市场水平来制定货币政策时，美联储威廉姆斯回答说：“绝对不会”，尽管央行正密切关注金融市场。威廉姆斯表示：“我们必须始终独立进行分析，认真开展工作，评估所有影响经济和前景的因素。”此外，威廉姆斯对人工智能的发展前景持积极态度，并表示近期该行业经历的一些起伏并不令人意外。他指出，资产价格波动“是这个高度创新、快速变化的世界所必然带来的，过去我们已经经历过类似情况。”谈到企业为扩张业务而借款时，他表示，当前的杠杆水平与二十年前导致金融危机的水平不同。“这些企业的盈利水平非常高，因此我现在并不太担心杠杆带来的金融稳定
text_en: Jinshi Data August 3 - When asked whether the Federal Reserve would be constrained by market levels in setting monetary policy, Fed's Williams replied, 'Absolutely not,' despite the central bank closely monitoring financial markets. Williams said, 'We must always conduct independent analysis, do our work carefully, and assess all factors affecting the economy and outlook.' Additionally, Williams holds a positive view on AI development and said some recent ups and downs in the industry are not surprising. He noted that asset price volatility 'comes with this highly innovative, fast-changing world, and we have seen similar situations before.' Regarding companies borrowing to expand operations, he said current leverage levels differ from those that led to the financial crisis two decades ago. 'These companies are highly profitable, so I am not too worried about financial stability risks from leverage right now.'
